scope: Product-flow audit of the existing study site; rendered-link coverage across the entire build. This is not a fresh semantic review of every teaching paragraph.

environment.browser: Codex in-app browser, actual device speech voices
environment.preview: Home and Library are separately rendered and explicitly aliased on the case-insensitive local filesystem. Linux CI checks the native artifact.

steps.notes: Start/search/lane entry points inspected. Excluded SDE guides now link to their public repository source with an explicit label.
Lane destinations explicit, learning paths retained, counts restamped by their owner.
All seven rendered entry pages inspected for orientation, study passes, onward links and overflow. Corrected backend Sub-stacks badge through check_counts.
Query, material and stack filters, revision discovery, empty results and recovery inspected. Revision context distinguishes repeated titles; one clear-search icon.
Coding-pattern passes and Linear Structures chapter table inspected; revision remains a separate companion.
Word and paragraph emphasis inspected with native Samantha speech in both themes. Desktop arrow aligned with dock; mobile arrow in context row; Back to top returned to scrollY=0. Wide remains fixed.
All 43 answers in the Execution & Scope companion opened through Show all answers. No overflow observed.
Interview filter reaches the real bank. Reader, outline, breadcrumb and listening now also mount on banks; no revision wrapping or learning-resume claim.
320-pixel settings, mobile navigation, 44-pixel transport targets and responsive arrow ownership inspected. Removed observed legacy and character voices.
Inspected mobile cancelled-sign-in state and the retained chapter return destination. OAuth was not submitted; signed-in production rendering requires a probe credential.

findings.issue: Arrow floated above the audio dock; current word competed with paragraph and callout stripes.
Source-existing but excluded SDE lane destinations were exposed as site links.
Six priority badges had incorrect parent depth, one category badge used a removed fragment, and CI/CD references omitted INDEX.
Image-wrapped badge destinations could open raw Markdown; the reader now resolves only catalog-listed HTML counterparts.
Repeated revision titles lacked category context, and a mixed-vendor selector caused duplicate clear icons.
Heading names duplicated permalink labels in accessibility navigation; interview banks lacked reader tools.
Backend sub-stack count drifted and adjacent Markdown separators promoted explanatory prose to large headings.
Device menu still exposed observed older and character voices despite Samantha being the default.
Linux found eight audit-page directory links that relied on case-insensitive INDEX lookup. Links now name their landing page and the publication checker uses exact emitted filenames on every OS.

browserObservations.nativeSpeech: Samantha word boundary events observed in light and dark

verification.build: Pinned Ruby 3.4.11 production Jekyll build succeeded; no Liquid warnings or exceptions
verification.fixpoint: All 10 documented writers leave the final corpus byte-identical.
verification.separatorRepair: 31 separators in 23 files plus the Coding Patterns landing-page separator corrected; original prose and code preserved.
verification.release: Commit, push and merge authorized by the user; deployment outcome is verified separately after shipping.
verification.caseSensitivity: The new case fixture failed on macOS before the exact-file inventory change, then passed. The checker reproduced all eight Linux findings locally before their source links were repaired.

limits: No new paragraph-by-paragraph semantic review of all 678 catalog topics.
Native word events were observed for Samantha; voices that do not provide boundary events retain paragraph emphasis.
No external voice service is used. Device availability and acoustic quality vary.
Local sign-in recovery was inspected without submitting OAuth. Signed-in production body rendering is not established without STUDY_PROBE_TOKEN.
No manual screen-reader session was performed; accessible names and keyboard controls were inspected through DOM behavior and browser state.
